settings.capture_mode.note: DXGI: lowest overhead, tied to the capture monitor’s GPU. WGC: works across GPUs, cursor drawn by Windows (yellow border on Windows 10). Window: only that window is mirrored — alt-tab never shows your desktop. Changing the mode clears the capture target.

settings.target_missing: ⚠ Saved output monitor "{0}" is not connected right now.
settings.scale_filter.unscaled: Source and output are the same size → drawn 1:1, no filter applied.
filter.bilinear.name: Bilinear
filter.bilinear.desc: Default · fastest; thin lines get rough beyond ~1.5× shrink · cost: minimal
filter.bilinear.option: Bilinear — Default · fastest; thin lines get rough beyond ~1.5× shrink · cost: minimal
filter.area.name: Area (box average)

settings.struct_note: Structure (monitor/mode/bit depth/window) applies only after a restart.
settings.target_fps.note: Only with VSync off — with VSync on, the display refresh paces the output.
settings.fps_overlay.note: For verification — the readout is drawn into the mirrored picture, so it is visible on the output monitor (and a capture card) too.
settings.audio_mirror: Mirror audio to the output monitor (HDMI/DP)
settings.audio_mirror.note: Tick the devices to mix and send to the output monitor. Output devices are captured as they sound (e.g. speakers plus the headset Discord plays to), input devices as they come in (e.g. a microphone). Gain in dB: common + device (e.g. +10 and -5 → +5 dB).
audio.status.idle: waiting for the mirror to start
audio.status.paused_same: paused — the default output device is the output monitor itself ("{0}")
audio.status.no_target_name: disabled — the output monitor reports no name (EDID), so its audio device can't be identified
audio.status.target_not_found: disabled — no active audio device found for the output monitor "{0}"
audio.out.label: Mix output device
audio.out.note: Automatic uses the output monitor’s HDMI/DP audio. Pick a device if it isn’t found (different name, identical monitors).
settings.audio_follow_volume: Follow the volume and mute of output devices
settings.audio_follow_volume.note: On: turning an output device down or muting it in Windows changes the mirror the same way, as you hear it. Off: the mirror gets the device’s sound as Windows captures it (for many devices the volume is already in it, but not the mute). Microphones are always left as Windows delivers them.
audio.status.output_not_found: disabled — output device "{0}" is not connected
audio.src.render_header: Output devices — capture what they play
settings.agent_bind.note: "+" = reachable from the network  ·  "localhost" = local only
settings.agent_enabled: HTTP agent enabled (OBS dock / remote control)
settings.autostart_mirror: Start mirroring automatically when the app starts
settings.login_autostart: Start the app automatically at Windows login
settings.agent_note: Agent/bind/port changes apply after an app restart.
